title: On Beating the older boy at chess
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：beat　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 beat 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the coach ① beat the older boy at chess year after year, and every player in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the coach ② beats the older boy at chess for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ beat the older boy at chess at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ beaten the older boy at chess before — a line in the record for April 1974 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Beating the older boy at chess year after year, the coach said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the whistle at the far stand, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ beat the brass bell till it rang for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Beat the brass bell till it rang at once and never mention it again.

By 1987 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new player from the next field ⑧ beats the brass bell till it rang year after year every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stand, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ beat the older boy at chess again when nobody else would.

⑩ To beat the older boy at chess, my mother said in 1992, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody beats the older boy at chess for the whole place again and somebody must beat the older boy at chess year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 击败（一般过去式 beat the older boy at chess：1980 年教练头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 击败（一般现在 beats the older boy at chess：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 击败（不定式 to beat the older boy at chess：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 击败（过去完成时 had beaten the older boy at chess：1974 年四月的赛事记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 击败（动名词 beating the older boy at chess 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 敲响（beat the brass bell till it rang：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去敲响那只铜铃直到敲响）
G. v. 敲响（beat the brass bell till it rang：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 击败（后段两处：新来的队员照例 beats the brass bell till it rang，而母亲又一次 beat the older boy at chess）

beat 意为“击败”，结尾那句是母亲 1992 年的话：要击败下棋赢了那个大孩子，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和球场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 beat 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1980 the coach beat the older boy at chess year after year, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the coach beats the older boy at chess for the whole place whenever the field asks.
Beating the older boy at chess year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever beat the brass bell till it rang for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new player from the next field beats the brass bell till it rang year after year every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother beat the older boy at chess again, and the field remembered that half.
